Pressure ratio = (eardrum area ÷ footplate area) × lever ratio.\nPressure gain = 20 log₁₀(pressure ratio).\nFor the lossless model, the volume-velocity ratio is the inverse of the pressure ratio.

The ideal lossless, frequency-independent transformer omits stiffness, damping and the cochlear load. A pressure gain in dB is not an absolute sound level, energy gain, hearing threshold or personal measurement. No tones are played.
